## Rule

Input is always a 10×10 grid with one non-background color. The colored object contains a solid 2×2 block and one to three diagonal tail cells adjacent to the block corners. Output preserves the object and extends each present tail diagonally away from the 2×2 block until the 10×10 boundary; background remains color 0 inside the 10×10 output and all channels stay zero outside the padded 30×30 tensor.

## Algorithm sketch

Best cheap ONNX rewrite: slice only channel 0 over the active 10×10 crop and cast it to UINT8. A 2×2 MaxPool over channel 0 is zero exactly at the solid 2×2 foreground block, so row/column ReduceMin + ArgMin recovers the block coordinates without a 2×2 Conv or a full block mask. Shared dynamic gathers probe the top and bottom tail rows, precomputed F16 coordinate grids define the two diagonals, and scalar tail probes gate the four diagonal ray masks. The final graph pads only the 1-channel extension mask to 30×30, multiplies the detected non-background color channels by `[0,1,...,1]`, and overlays extensions onto the original one-hot input with `Where`.
